relevance.rationale: Classical non-equilibrium statistical mechanics: it recasts Zwanzig's derivation of a NONLINEAR generalized Langevin equation from the heat-bath Hamiltonian H(X,Y) = H_s(X) + (1/2)[Y - a(X)]^T K [Y - a(X)] (eq. 3), argues Zwanzig's kernel and noise definitions (eqs. 7-8) make the friction function ill-defined — a tautological fluctuation-dissipation relation and an unbounded kernel in the continuum limit — and supplies readjusted definitions plus a renormalization separating the equilibrium map's coupling-coefficient dependence from its system-variable dependence. Citation status checked three ways: no ref() entry (greps over folio/schema/references.ts on the author surname, the DOI suffix, the ISSN and 'zwanzig' all return empty), no \cite site in content/**/*.md, no '-- Ref:' in content/**/*.lean; the sole corpus occurrence of the string 'cairano' is this document's own row in folio/bib-qa-verifications.json. Corpus-side grep is empty for 'langevin', 'zwanzig', 'memory kernel', 'fluctuation-dissipation', 'heat bath', 'colored noise', 'master equation', 'stochastic differential' across content/ and docs/. The adjacency is thematic and two removes deep: sec:brane-fluid asserts that the q-Laplacian's algebraically quantised eigenvalues [k]_q make 'the viscous dissipation rate algebraically quantised', and the stochastic-mechanics chapter intro claims the Markov trace acts as a transition kernel recovering Brownian motion at q -> 1 — both are dissipative/stochastic claims that a Zwanzig-Mori projection would be the classical template for deriving. But (i) the corpus reaches its classical limit by a completely different route, def:classical-limit-functor's monoidal functor with hbar_q = 1 - q^{-1} -> 0, with no bath, no projection operator and no memory kernel anywhere; and (ii) the template itself is Zwanzig's original paper, not this one, which is a technical correction to Zwanzig's kernel/noise bookkeeping. So there is no result here the folio can consume, and no named block that wants one. Scope-(a) negative: this document, as read, supplies nothing usable here; it is not a claim that Zwanzig-Mori coarse-graining is excluded as a route to brane-fluid dissipation.

proposedActions.rationale: Orphan with no citation site and no consumable statement; the corpus has zero GLE/memory-kernel/FDT content for it to attach to, so add-reference would be inflation. Revisit only if the folio starts an actual derivation of sec:brane-fluid's 'algebraically quantised viscous dissipation' from a substrate Hamiltonian by projection-operator coarse-graining — and then the primary source is Zwanzig, with this paper as the correction to his kernel/noise definitions.
